dedupeText: mid century garage rock album layout mid century garage rock mop top 1960s band portrait film grain vibrant red black background large central portrait dominates the middle third of the frame bold red display text creates a strong horizontal anchor at the top small repetitive rectangular frames at the bottom provide rhythmic detail high contrast lighting on subjects against a deep black background creates depth combine a high contrast group portrait with a black field footer containing small action shots tied together by bold red vintage display typography and thin white rules

retrievalProfile.description: A multi-panel layout featuring a large group portrait above smaller candid action shots, characterized by high-contrast black backgrounds and bold red typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tier vertical composition with a header containing decorative text, a central large-scale group portrait of a band in 1960s attire, and a bottom footer featuring a row of smaller, rectangular candid studio photographs against a solid black field.
coreVisualRelationships: Large central portrait dominates the middle third of the frame
Bold red display text creates a strong horizontal anchor at the top
Small repetitive rectangular frames at the bottom provide rhythmic detail
High-contrast lighting on subjects against a deep black background creates depth
coreInvariants: Solid black background for the lower half
Warm, saturated color palette in the photography
Horizontal white divider lines separating sections

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Band members are arranged in a shallow V-formation, waist-up, filling the center horizontal band.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red title text in the upper third acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top decorative header, move down to the main portrait, and finally scan the smaller detail images at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space in the bottom half isolates the smaller inset photos.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background provides high contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red for primary typography and graphic accents.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm earth tones (browns, oranges, yellows) within the photography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and warm tones against a zero-value black base.

letterConstructionRules: Top line uses an ornate, high-contrast serif with exaggerated swashes on capitals
Second line uses a heavy, slightly irregular slab-serif with a hand-drawn feel
Footer text uses a clean, bold sans-serif for legibility
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exaggerated descenders and ascenders on the main title
Slightly uneven baseline for the secondary title to mimic woodblock printing
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Ornate decorative serif paired with a rugged slab-serif and a functional sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Crescent-shaped decorative brackets in the header

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the ornate 60s serif feel of the top line
Matches the heavy slab-serif feel of the secondary title

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a band portrait of five men with 1960s mop-top haircuts and sweaters, positioned against a dark background. Below them, place four small rectangular candid photos of the band in a recording studio against a solid black field.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a top header with ornate red serif text and a secondary line of bold red slab-serif text. Separate the sections with thin white horizontal lines.

verificationChecks: Are the band members wearing 1960s era clothing?
Is the background behind the bottom photos solid black?
Is the primary text color a vibrant, saturated red?

adjustableVariables: Number of inset photos in the footer
Specific shade of red used for text

mustAchieve: Authentic 1960s film grain and color grading

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent lighting across all photographic elements
Ensure the red text is the most vibrant element on the page
Verify the presence of thin white horizontal dividers
Confirm the 'mop-top' hairstyle is present on subjects
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast group portrait with a black-field footer containing small action shots, tied together by bold red vintage display typography and thin white rules.
